notes.title: Releasing 7-minute HOP
notes.notes:
Hello!
We have released our new game "7-minute HOP". This is easy to play this cute game. You have to reach as high as possible in this infinite world.
Also we have added customization for your alien. To get it, you have to play 4 hour. Then you can find it in your  inventory. We are going to add some achievements soon, too.
